results.title: CG Power Reports ₹313 Crore Q1 Profit, Up 16.2%; Approves ₹35.17 Crore Nashik Expansion
results.description: CG Power and Industrial Solutions announced a 16.2% increase in consolidated net profit to ₹313.01 crore for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company's board also approved a ₹35.17 crore brownfield expansion project in Nashik to double manufacturing capacity

results.title: Chinese battery giant CATL sees profit surge on energy storage demand
results.description: Chinese battery giant Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited (CATL) saw net profit surge 42 percent compared to the same period last year, a company filing showed Friday. CATL's net profit during the first half of the year was 43 billion yuan ($6.4 billion), the filing to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange showed, as demand for energy storage critical to the AI industry grows.

results.title: India targets Formula 1 comeback by 2028 with new Task Force, FMSCI recognition
results.description: The Union Sports Ministry provisionally recognizes the FMSCI as an NSF, establishing a task force to drive Formula 1's return to India by 2028.
